resources.string: These optional inputs describe requested training resources. Saving them does not allocate compute or start a training run.
Enter GPU hours as an exact JSON number, zero or greater. No maximum or recommended budget is supplied.
Enter a whole number of minutes, at least 1.
Not supplied, false and true are distinct. Allowing spot usage does not confirm its availability or change whether this component is enabled.
Enter a value or clear the supply option.
Enter an exact JSON number without grouping or locale separators.
Enter an exact JSON whole number without grouping or locale separators.
This input exceeds the local editor limit.
Pending input is retained only within the local recovery limit and requires explicit review. Recovering input does not confirm a save or start training.
